name: Light Rays
description: Shafts of light burst from the highlights of the first clip and stream outward from a slowly drifting center; at their peak the second clip takes over and its own rays shrink back into its highlights. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Point the rays stream away from, at the middle of the transition (0..1, y down)

params.name: drift
params.description: How far the center drifts during the transition, from left to right

params.name: reach
params.description: Length of the rays at the peak, as a fraction of their distance to the center

params.name: threshold
params.description: Brightness above which the picture casts rays

params.name: tint
params.description: Tint of the rays, toward their ends
